tmp:1858: ba'al aveirah — the habitual sinner/transgressor as a personal type, deemed insane per Sotah 3a's 'spirit of folly'
tmp:1859: meshuga — madman/insane state; the sinner's condition caused by the entering ruach shtut (spirit of folly)
tmp:1861: mashukh be'orlato — 'drawn/extended in his foreskin' (one who stretches skin to undo circumcision); emblem of pegam habrit (covenant blemish) caused by unelevated Aramaic/Targum
tmp:1863: shoresh hamalkhut — the root of Kingship (sefirah of Malkhut), identified with Mashiach per 'and raise the horn of His anointed' (I Sam 2), where arrogance's evil eye must be subdued
tmp:1866: shishim giborim — the 'sixty mighty men' around Solomon's bed (Song 3:7), kabbalistic gevurot from which sustenance/rain descends; hinted in Rabbah bar bar Chanah's 'sixty cities'
tmp:1867: the flow of parnassah (livelihood) issuing from the sixty giborim/gevurot, as in 'gevurot geshamim' — rains as mighty acts (Berakhot 33a)
tmp:1868: the drop-by-drop descent (of rain/bounty) from the gevurot — thunder-linked trickle of sustenance descending in individual drops
tmp:1870: Mishneh Torah — 'the repetition of the Torah' (Deuteronomy), wordplay with lechem mishneh (double Shabbat bread): doubled Torah insights innovated on Shabbat
tmp:1872: 'meimekha' ('your water,' Num 20:19, Edom episode) — water as symbol of mishpat/judgment, per 'let judgment roll down like water' (Amos 5:24)
tmp:1874: the verse 'mishpatim bal yeda'um' (Ps 147:20, 'judgments they did not know') — gentile courts' alien judgments empowered when an unworthy rabbi is ordained
tmp:1875: mishpat me'ukal — 'crooked/perverted judgment' (Hab 1:4): distorted justice of gentile courts/writings, opposite of clear mishpat
tmp:1876: mishpetei hanhagot yesharot — upright judgments/norms of conduct on the middle path, attained via faith in the Sages
tmp:1877: 'mishpetei emet' — 'true judgments' (Ps 19:10): clear, true judgment emerging through emunat chakhamim and the central pillar
tmp:1878: one immersed/sunk in ta'avat mamon (lust for money) — the state of anpin chashukhin (darkened countenance), diagnosable when the master cannot see himself in the student
tmp:1879: met — a corpse/death itself, the avi avot hatum'ah (ultimate source of ritual impurity), equated with adulterous thoughts from which tzedakah saves ('charity saves from death')
tmp:1880: the prevailing/triumph of the tzaddikim over the wicked via the ruach chaim (spirit of life) — Rashi's 'future standing and rising for the righteous' on 'tzvi latzaddik'
tmp:1881: the act of binding and attaching oneself to God and His tzaddikim — the peacemaking/unification achieved through resolving disputes, raising mayin nukvin
tmp:1882: the yetzer hara's initial tactic of garbing itself in mitzvot — enticing a person as if to a mitzvah; the deceptive 'white fire' (tzutzita denura chivarta) that is nonetheless a destructive angel
tmp:1884: tefillah ketikkuno — prayer performed in its proper/rectified form, which sparks the light of zekhut avot ('chalah zekhut avot,' via 'vayechal Moshe')
tmp:1885: the sparkling illumination the heart (lev) receives from the 32 (lamed-bet) occurrences of 'Elokim' in the Creation account — source of the heart's name and light
tmp:1886: the shining of the Patriarchs' lights (orot ha'avot: Avraham-Yitzchak as right/left hands, Yaakov as neder) upon a person when the hands are rectified by a vow
tmp:1887: praying also with yirah (awe/fear of God) — the awe flowing from humility ('ekev anavah yirat Hashem'), yirah being Malkhut, joined to prayer
tmp:1888: praying and begging forgiveness for one's sins — the penitent's supplication accompanying teshuvah and the shame that becomes the light of tefillin
tmp:1889: kodem gezar din — the temporal stage 'before the decree is sealed,' when prayer may be uttered plainly in its standard order without disguise
tmp:1890: praying in the fixed liturgical order without 'clothing' the prayer — the undisguised mode of petition permitted before the decree, since no angelic accusers need be evaded
tmp:1892: rectifying/building one's own personal malkhut (kingship-structure) by hearing holy melody — the sense of 'aseh lekha rav' in Avot 1
tmp:1893: rectifying and elevating the aspect of Malkhut back to its root — restoring kingship to God, effected by verbal confession before a talmid chakham
tmp:1894: the proportional increase of da'at (knowledge/awareness) — the measure by which peace and easy livelihood grow
tmp:1895: the increase of compassion and peace — and consequent ease of parnassah — that results from expanded da'at ('the earth is full of knowledge,' Isa 11)
tmp:1896: nisu'in shel rasha — the 'marriage/union of the wicked one' (the serpent's seductive coupling), the adulterous liaison from which tzitzit protects
tmp:1897: ni'uf — adultery/sexual licentiousness as the category of sin countered by the mitzvah of tzitzit (covering the arayot)
tmp:1898: being attached to the tzaddik and believing in him — the mere faith-attachment that benefits one's divine service even without receiving teaching
tmp:1899: being 'eaten' by the tzaddik and transformed into the tzaddik's very essence — the food-becomes-eater metaphor ('a land that consumes its inhabitants,' Num 13) for the follower's absorption
tmp:1901: chazan — the cantor/prayer-leader, so named from chazon (prophetic vision) because his melody draws from the place from which prophets suckle
tmp:1902: menagen — the musician/singer of melody, whose neginah issues from the two live pure birds nursing from the prophetic source
tmp:1903: the multiplying/increasing of prayer — each added prayer, though seeming barren, is 'kneaded and baked,' further building the Shekhinah
tmp:1904: the progressive building of the Shekhinah's stature through accumulated prayers, preparing Her for the zivug (union) — the true fruit of seemingly unanswered prayers
tmp:1905: the rebuilding of Jerusalem as 'kiryah ne'emanah' (faithful city, Isa 1) = attaining emunah (faith), achieved through holy boldness (azut dikedushah)
tmp:1906: the creation of heaven and earth — the world-creating power latent in Torah novelties born of the imaginative faculty resting on those who repeat halakhot
tmp:1907: the growth/magnification of shalom (peace) — peace enlarged in step with da'at, enabling opposites ('wolf with lamb,' Isa 11) to dwell together
